- scripts/security_audit.sh:1318-1343 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The partial-coverage block unconditionally appends the SHA marker, the "Last audited commit" label, and the partial-coverage marker to the existing tracker body every run where over-cap text is skipped. When the tracker body already carries those markers from a prior partial-coverage run, each subsequent run duplicates them.
  WHY: The tracker body grows by roughly 200 bytes per partial-coverage run. The Python tracker parser uses `re.search` (first match), so duplicates are parsed correctly today, but the body accumulates redundant content on every weekly run where the over-cap file is not removed. Over months of repeated partial scans the body drifts toward the GitHub 65 536-character edit limit without any self-healing path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
